reviews.title: Careful if you try
reviews.text: If you get the app as a trial or as a member be careful to cancel when you want the app acts super sketch when you try to cancel. Customer service is no help. App itself not worth it

reviews.title: Great for gym goers but hard to cancel!!!
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for a while and it’s good and served its purpose. Trying to cancel subscription has been a nightmare- I hate when companies/apps do this. Go from trying to help people into scamming people. Can’t cancel in the app and makes you go to their website. Get to their website as soon as you hit cancel subscription it starts glitching and literally won’t do it for you!!!

reviews.title: Deceitful subscription
reviews.text: I was excited to sign up for this app which offered the option of a 7-day trial followed by a 1 year subscription. I didn’t realise that it charges you on the day of subscribing so you actually DON’T have a 7-day trial?! Refund refused too, misleading and false advertising of the app, which I’m very disappointed in. Buyers beware.

reviews.title: Do NOT Purchase!
reviews.text: App is not great with regular issues. They have even worse customer service. I purchased the app at 30% off and within a week or two they offered 40%. Almost all companies offer a two week price adjustment. However when I reached out to EvolveYou, they refused to honor the now reduced price. Awful customer service especially when it’s roughly $10. So they’d rather lose a customer for life make a customer happy and price adjust for a difference of $10 a year. I’ll be canceling and going to the Whitney Simmons app. Don’t waste your time or money !!!!

reviews.title: Charged in day 1 of 7 day free trial!
reviews.text: Downloaded app yesterday, used today and decided not for me, made sure I cancelled everything well as had read warnings about auto renewal. But I got charged today anyway. What a scam. I hope trading standards come for this company soon.

reviews.title: Glitches constantly
reviews.text: You cannot watch the workouts because they constantly freeze up every other move freezes no idea what you’re supposed to be doing.

reviews.title: ⚠️ BEWARE BEFORE SUBSCRIBING: Worst Customer Service & Predatory Billing
reviews.text:
Do not fall for this app. This is the absolute worst customer service I have ever experienced.
Broken App & Zero Support: I was completely locked out of my account for months. I reached out for technical help, but they failed to fix the issue. Because the app was completely unusable, I had to abandon it and switch to a competitor.
Predatory Auto-Renewal: Months later, I received an invoice for an automatic annual renewal. I immediately contacted them on the exact same day to cancel and request a refund.
Unreasonable Refund Policy: They refused to refund my money, hiding behind a strict policy stating that cancellations must be made 24 hours before the renewal date. Because of a matter of hours, they forced me to pay for an entire year of a service that I cannot even log into.
Ignoring Evidence: I explicitly asked them to check their own system logs to prove that I have not used the app in months. Instead of addressing this, they just blindly sent me my account info. They completely refuse to acknowledge that I am paying for a broken, unused service.
Lack of Transparency: Unlike reputable apps (like FORM) that send a courtesy reminder email before charging an annual renewal, this company quietly processes the payment to trap your money.
Save your money, time, and sanity. Do not subscribe to this app. They do not care about their users; they only care about keeping your money.

reviews.title: No warning of renewal
reviews.text: No warning for the renewal, asked to cancel on the day of renewal but was refused although I hadn’t used any of the annual subscription

reviews.title: AVOID THIS PLATFORM
reviews.text: AVOID THIS PLATFORM. Purchased in 2025, used all of twice as its rubbish. Basic functions, no value for money. Was charged a renewal fee without any correspondence/reminders at all, and even after getting in touch within 24 hours of the charge explaining I’ve not used it & don't intend to, they’re refusing to refund me. Horrific customer service. Completely immoral. Please be really careful with this money grabbing brand.

reviews.title: No continuity between app and website subscriptions
reviews.text: Systems don’t talk to each other and I paid for two accounts at the same time without realizing. I wrote the company back to see if I could get a partial refund and they refused because it was “agreed to at sign up” for each account. Not a girl’s girl move on the part of the company, especially in this economy. People before businesses.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: These guys charge much more than any other product on the market and their trial is only 3 days which they do a great job hiding. I was going to trial it and was charged before I even got a proper chance to try it out, with no recourse for a refund through Apple Store (I applied for a refund and was rejected). This review - as small and meaningless as it is in the grand scheme of things - is what the $23 you scammed from me bought you.

reviews.title: Poor app!!
reviews.text: Content is lacking no new workouts or recipes! Wasted my money and customer service is shocking! Don’t bother!

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text:
This app has gone so downhill. 
When it started it was good. Now it crashes always. Freezes. Voice overs down work. Its very unstable and unreliable. Im exploring other apps. Despite being loyal to this one for many years because it was very good. Now it is very bad and not work the money.

reviews.title: HIIT based program
reviews.text: The app is great if you like hiit workouts.

reviews.title: Impossible to Cancel
reviews.text: Beware, they’ll keep charging you even though it looks like you cancelled the subscription.

reviews.title: Customer service was horrible
reviews.text: I signed up for a one-year subscription through their website and was disappointed to find that when the renewal date came around, I did not receive any reminder before being charged for another full year. I contacted customer service the same day the charge appeared on my credit card, hoping to resolve the issue promptly. Unfortunately, I was told there was nothing they could do, and a refund was not an option. This was extremely frustrating, as a simple reminder could have prevented the situation entirely. I would have expected more flexibility and understanding, especially given how quickly I reached out. This experience has left me disappointed in their customer service and policies. Try at your own risk!

reviews.title: Great until it wasn’t
reviews.text:
With the web-based subscription, there are no options to manage it. No way to cancel or change it. I followed the instructions on their FAQ page and they’re useless. The option to cancel or manage subscription is not where the forum describes. I only have the option to renew- which also doesn’t work. 
I’ve had the app for a year and really enjoyed all the variability it had to offer. I never had any issues until the renewal. My payment method had expired and it didn’t automatically renew. Normally, an easy fix. However even though I updated my payment the app won’t charge it and continues to say there’s an error. With a predicted 3-4 day turn around, I don’t see the point of missing almost a weeks worth of workouts for what should have been a simple solution. Honestly a real turn off for the app. Don’t think it’s worth it. I’ve submitted a request today, I’ll update my review once resolved to give a comprehensive review of their customer service in response to bugs like this.

reviews.title: No reminder emails before annual renewals
reviews.text:
If desired, be sure to cancel your membership before your renewal date. There is no reminder email prior to your card being charged and the customer support team has no leniency on the policy. They also take days to respond to your email in between communications. Very disappointed with this.

Additionally, I could have sworn that I cancelled my membership several months ago in the app before deleting it from my phone. But the customer service team directed me to the website to cancel. I’ve read multiple reviews that this seems to be an issue and now I’m wondering if I’ve experienced the same where I cancelled through the app, but needed to cancel through the website also. Again, very disappointed.

reviews.title: App crashes
reviews.text: Since the last update the app crashes at the end of every workout and won’t let me save it. I then have to remember my weights and reps, to then edit it in afterwards

reviews.title: Do not use pregnancy program
reviews.text:
Pregnancy program is basically the same workout every week. Waste of money to pay for it. Don’t recommend. Better fitness apps out there with more creative pregnancy programs. 

Also if you had tone and sculpt before - you don’t qualify for a free trial even if it says so at checkout so you will get charged immediately. Company will not refund or make exceptions so proceed with caution before enrolling. 

YouTube has better options or the new Kayla Itsines app.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: The app is alright, I’ve had it for years but the worst customer service, I’ve seen from any subscription app, makes it not worth it.

reviews.title: Beware, sign up for year subscription without clear warnings
reviews.text: I am an avid gym goer, and also home gym user. I’ve purchased and tried many apps over the years. This app wasn’t very engaging and not user friendly for my purposes so I decided not to continue although I had paid for the year. When I purchased it, I was given the impression it was a yearly charge not a subscription annually reviews. There is no mention of it being a subscription in my sign-up email. So imagine my surprise, after not using it for many months when I’m suddenly charged a fee for it! Apparently I had to log into their website to unsubscribe from something I didn’t believe I’d subscribe to. The app doesn’t care and states that I’ve agreed to this. There is no mention of this in any emails I’ve had. So if you are tempted to try and do pay, be warned you are signing up to an annual automatic subscription, not a one of fee.

reviews.title: Need help canceling
reviews.text: I will alter this review if I can get in contact with someone on the team to verify my subscription was canceled, I signed up using Apple and read the reviews after the fact, I cancelled through Apple itself but apparently you have to on the site as well? I can’t even login on the site since I used my Apple ID

reviews.title: Cancelling made difficult
reviews.text: It’s not a bad app. I’m restarting my fitness journey after a few years off & didn’t feel like this app was the right fit for what I needed. WHICH IS FINE - it’s great for other people that want this structure. However, I thought I cancelled my subscription the day after I started the free trial. 6 days later I got an alert that I was being charged $120 for the yearly subscription which would’ve been fine if I was going to continue using it. I didn’t realize I had to also cancel in the app AND log in to their site online to cancel a THIRD time. The virtual assistant said there is nothing that can be done about the charge unless I dispute it directly through Apple (although I already cancelled it so it doesn’t show on my Apple charges). For future trial users, I hope this process isn’t such a headache for others if they decide this app is not the right fit for them either.

reviews.title: Good for beginners
reviews.text: As someone who is pretty knowledgeable in lifting i think this app is good for beginners but not for those who know what they are doing. Make sure you let them know a head of time that you want to cancel because turning off automatic renewal isn’t hood enough.

reviews.title: BEWARE OF AUTO RENEW
reviews.text:
PSA: If you want to cancel your subscription to this app, confirm you did it through their website. If you cancel your account through Apple/the app, it will still auto renew. When that happens they basically middle finger you requesting your money back. The app is cool enough, customer service sucks and they don’t operate in transparency when it comes to canceling subscriptions.

Edit: I looked into other peoples experiences and realized I’m not the only person that this has happened to.

2nd Edit in response to the developer: I’m a 32 year old millennial who doesn’t use a computer. I found out about EvolveYou on instagram that routed me to the App Store which is where I signed up. I had never been to EvolveYou’s website prior to trying to figure out why I had been charged a renewal. I had to have customer support help me with logging to in to my account because the email that was used for auto renewal said it was invalid. I’m paying for another year on the technicality that I missed the email they sent me for the auto renewal of a subscription THAT I ALREADY CANCELED. Fix the transparency around HOW to properly cancel a membership because the support page is a joke. Would give 0 stars if it was an option.

reviews.title: Screen has shrunk!
reviews.text: My app screen when opened is nearly half the size unsure why!

reviews.title: The app crashes every single time I use it
reviews.text: This is the first review I have ever written and honestly I am so frustrated with this app, I wish I never had bought the membership outright 🙁. The app, without fail, crashes once if not multiple teams every time I use it, and currently that’s three times a week. I then lose my flow of workout or have to stop and most of the time it takes a good 5-10 minutes for the app to load and forgets where I was in the workout. A complete waste of money and I’m so disappointed, wish I had never bought it

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: I loved this app the first year I used it. Now that it has renewed for another year I cannot access the app.  At first it erased my history, note I can’t log in.   I am ready to cancel.

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: I had purchased a year subscription for the app to give it a try. I used it for a few months but found I am more of a group workout type of person. I could not cancel the subscription since I had paid for a year, no big deal worth a try! Later in the year around Black Friday I remembered the year was almost up and was waiting for a reminder email about the subscription to renew so I could opt out. The app had been off my phone for so long I couldn’t even get in to it. However the notification never came, I got charged a full additional year for a service I hadn’t used in over half a year. And I immediately emailed customer service that day requesting my subscription be terminated with a refund (again since it was that exact day) and they were less than helpful and essentially told me that type of communication doesn’t exist in their service and that it was too late. A one year subscription to a booming company like that is nothing, and I say booming because Krissy reports her brands success all over her instagram, but to one customer during the holiday season is much more. Disappointed.

reviews.title: Price has gone up. Quality has gone down
reviews.text:
I wasn’t aware that my payment hadn’t gone through last year and didn’t receive any notification about it, yet I was penalised for the issue, which felt unfair. I’m supposed to be charged the same price every year, which was £44.99, but the price was raised to £59.99 and presented as a “deal.” I wouldn’t pay more than £44.99.

The cost of the app has increased, but nothing additional appears to have been added to justify the higher price. I’m aware that Krissy has several business ventures, but this app feels like the most neglected of them all.

Over time, several trainers have left and multiple workout plans have been removed, which further reduces the value. For these reasons, I’ve decided to try another app, as this one is no longer the right fit for me.

reviews.title: Here’s a better app
reviews.text: Not worth it. There’s a much better app called Hevy that does way more for free. Evolve is clunky, changing exercises is a pain, there’s no clear overview of weight progress, and it glitches a lot. Also lost respect for the founder promoting body confidence while getting plastic surgery—it just doesn’t align and makes the brand hard to support.

reviews.title: Waste of Money
reviews.text: Poor and unhelpful customer service, an app that isn’t user-friendly, and workouts that are repetitive and buggy. For a paid fitness app, this is really disappointing. I wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.title: Broken payment link + Unreachable Support
reviews.text:
I have had an on ongoing issue for over two weeks, and at this point it is completely unacceptable.

I was offered a $59 annual web subscription by Jessica as a resolution for prior problems. I attempted repeatedly to complete payment, but the Stripe payment link provided by your team does not work and returns an error (“There is an issue with your account”), making payment impossible.

I contacted support multiple times and messaged Jessica directly via Facebook Messenger. Despite your stated 2–3 business day response window, I received no response at all — not before the billing date, not after it, and not at any point during this process.

I also attempted to reply to your emails and was met with delivery failures and automated responses, confirming that your communication channels are either broken or not monitored. At this point, it is clear that customers are being funneled into dead ends with no way to reach a human.

Let me be very clear: this is not an app issue, not an onboarding issue, and not user error. This is a billing failure caused by a broken payment link and a complete lack of support follow-through on your end.

As a result of your failure to respond or provide a working payment method, my account is now locked behind an in-app paywall that forces Apple billing at a different price — despite the fact that I attempted in good faith to pay the agreed-upon rate before the deadline and was prevented from doing so by your systems.

I am still willing to pay imm

reviews.title: Don’t recommend!
reviews.text: Zero communication from the company. Be sure you don’t have the subscription set up because they will automatically draft your account without any notice.

reviews.title: Charged although CANCELLED
reviews.text:
This app and evolve you had been nothing but disappointing. 

After signing up to a years subscription with high hopes, all I had was an app that freezes, shuts down and glitches every time I used it. Out of the year, I tried enduring for 2 months before giving up. 

I decided to cancel my subscription through the app, and was charged although i had CANCELLED it. When I reached out to them, I was told I had to unsubscribe on the website address, for the same account that I’d already cancelled through the app?! Are they not linked? Is this there way of conning you out of money - By making you have to ‘double unsubscribe’? 

To top it all off, the web address i apparently still have ‘access’ to, won’t even load and says I need to create and account because it no longer exists!?

So basically, if I create an account on the website, I can connect it to the app, but when i cancel my subscription through the app, it conveniently doesn’t connect to the same account online and charges anyway?! 

So now I have an active account, because I didn’t ’double unsubscribe’ - and it doesn’t even work either way!? Never again will I use this app, and you’d be saving yourself a lot of Hassle and money if you don’t either.

reviews.title: RENEWED WHEN CANCELLED/Unsubscrubed
reviews.text: I unsubscribed and canceled my membership for this app over a year ago and I’m still finding this app charging me! When I click unsubscribe, it gives me a page not found and I am getting the runaround! DO NOT PURCHASE

reviews.title: If I could give zero stars I would
reviews.text:
If I could give zero stars, I would.

I signed up to this app over a year ago and barely used it because, frankly, I don’t think it’s very good. I was under the impression that I had cancelled my subscription, but without any warning or reminder, they took an annual payment out of my account out of the blue.

I contacted customer support within minutes of the charge, assuming that, like any reputable company, there would be a cooling-off period or some flexibility. Unfortunately, despite the lack of notice and the fact I haven’t used the app, they refused to issue a refund.

Really disappointing experience. I would strongly advise avoiding this company.

reviews.title: Do not waste your time
reviews.text: I tried the free 7 day trial. It worked 50% of the time, I couldn’t log in to actually use the app. When it did work the time only works when the app and screen are open. Very disappointed just with the trial.

reviews.title: Terrible UX, no good for tracking progress
reviews.text:
There’s no way of tracking and viewing your previous workouts so you can’t see what reps or weights you have done in weeks before. It’s limited to just showing you your ‘previous entry’ on the last time you did that exercise.

The app is buggy and you can’t just click on an exercise to say you’ve completed it - and if you do the exercises in a different order (like when machines not avail in gym) you’ve got to physically move them in the app - otherwise if you do the ‘final’ exercise it automatically finishes your workout and you can’t go back and edit! You’ve got to click through and re input every exercise and remember every weight and rep! 

Spend more time on the app than lifting weights. DO NOT BUY

reviews.title: Talk Less, Optimize Time
reviews.text: Wish it was less talking. Most people don’t have time to listen to a slow intro and slow moving class. Especially not for a challenge. This format eats up any time you have to actually do the work out. Maybe make shorter, self paced versions of the challenges so they can be completed. Regular programs don’t offer much alternatives. The connection and login are not great. Loved the nutrition part of the app.

reviews.title: No longer worth it
reviews.text:
Because of this app I fell in love with the gym and I always get excited to workout. 

But I am changing my rating from 5 to 2 stars. I used to love this app so much when it was still less than £15 and the goal is to help women workout and a forum for women to inspire and interact but now it just feels money grabbing.
